gold_claim: Not claimed; requires independent contributors, bus factor >= 2, and regular non-author human review.
vulnerability_report_private_justificati: GitHub Private Vulnerability Reporting is enabled and SECURITY.md directs reporters to the private advisory form: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/SECURITY.md
vulnerability_report_response_justificat: No vulnerability report or GitHub security advisory has been received or published in the last six months. The documented target is acknowledgement within 48 hours: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/security/vulnerability-response.md
build_justification: The Python/Rust package and container are rebuilt from source with uv, maturin, Cargo, and Docker in required CI: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/development/validation-environment.md
build_common_tools_justification: The build uses common ecosystem tools: uv/pip-compatible metadata, maturin, Cargo, Docker, and GitHub Actions: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/pyproject.toml
build_floss_tools_justification: The documented build toolchain uses FLOSS tools (Python, uv, maturin, Rust/Cargo, Docker-compatible tooling): https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/development/validation-environment.md
test_justification: The public FLOSS test suites and exact commands are documented and run in CI: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/development/testing-policy.md
test_invocation_justification: Tests use standard ecosystem commands including uv run pytest and cargo test: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/quality/testing-policy.md
test_most_justification: The suite enforces a 75% Python coverage floor and includes unit, integration, native, hardware, external-tool, benchmark, fuzz, and compatibility lanes: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/development/testing-policy.md
test_continuous_integration_justificatio: Required GitHub Actions run tests on every pull request and protected main update: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yml
test_policy_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md requires tests for new features and security-sensitive changes: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
tests_are_added_justification: Recent feature, refactor, workflow, and security pull requests add or update regression tests, enforced by required CI: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/pulls?q=is%3Apr+is%3Amerged
tests_documented_added_justification: The contribution and testing policies explicitly require tests for new features and public/security-sensitive behavior: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
warnings_justification: Ruff, Pyright, cargo clippy with -D warnings, actionlint, and workflow/security linters run in required CI: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/development/testing-policy.md
warnings_fixed_justification: Required lint/type/Rust warning gates must pass before merge; accepted findings require explicit scoped handling: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/.github/workflows/quality.yml
warnings_strict_justification: Rust Clippy runs with -D warnings and Python/workflow linters run in strict required gates: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/development/coding-standards.md
know_secure_design_justification: The maintainer applies least privilege, fail-safe defaults, complete mediation, bounded inputs, and explicit trust boundaries documented in the threat model and input-validation policy: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/security/threat-model.md
know_common_errors_justification: The security policy and threat model identify injection, path traversal, authorization, dependency, secret, plugin, native-boundary, and resource-exhaustion risks with mitigations: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/SECURITY.md
crypto_published_justification: Project integrity/auth comparisons use published standard primitives such as SHA-256 and Python hmac.compare_digest; transport security is delegated to standard TLS platforms.
crypto_call_justification: ZapTrace does not implement custom cryptographic algorithms; it calls Python standard-library hashing/HMAC primitives and platform TLS.
crypto_floss_justification: Cryptographic functionality used by project code is provided by FLOSS Python/runtime and platform tooling.
crypto_keylength_justification: ZapTrace does not generate or manage encryption/signing keys or configurable cryptographic key lengths.
crypto_working_justification: Project code uses SHA-256 and constant-time comparison and does not depend on MD4, MD5, DES, RC4, or other broken default cryptographic algorithms.
crypto_weaknesses_justification: No default security mechanism in project code depends on SHA-1, insecure cipher modes, or another known-seriously-weakened algorithm.
crypto_pfs_justification: ZapTrace does not implement a key-agreement protocol; HTTPS/TLS termination is provided by the deployment platform.
crypto_password_storage_justification: ZapTrace does not store passwords for authentication of external users; deployments use externally supplied bearer tokens/platform controls.
crypto_random_justification: ZapTrace does not generate cryptographic keys or nonces as part of its security mechanisms.
delivery_unsigned_justification: Project/release URLs use HTTPS; release artifacts have SHA-256 manifests and GitHub build-provenance attestations with documented verification: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/security/release-verification.md
vulnerabilities_fixed_60_days_justificat: No public or draft ZapTrace security advisory or known unpatched medium-or-higher project vulnerability exists; dependency/security scans run continuously: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/security
vulnerabilities_critical_fixed_justifica: No known unresolved critical ZapTrace vulnerability exists; the documented response process prioritizes critical reports and coordinated fixes: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/security/vulnerability-response.md
no_leaked_credentials_justification: GitHub secret scanning and push protection are enabled, and required Gitleaks scans pass on pull requests and main: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/actions/workflows/gitleaks.yml
static_analysis_justification: CodeQL, Semgrep, SonarCloud, Ruff, Pyright, and Rust Clippy run before merge and on main: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/.github/workflows/security-scan.yml
static_analysis_common_vulnerabilities_j: CodeQL and Semgrep security rules inspect common vulnerability classes in required CI: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/.github/workflows/security-scan.yml
static_analysis_fixed_justification: Confirmed exploitable medium-or-higher findings block security gates or are handled through the private vulnerability process; no such unresolved project finding is known.
static_analysis_often_justification: Static analysis runs for every pull request and protected main update: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/actions/workflows/security-scan.yml
dynamic_analysis_justification: A deterministic untrusted-input fuzz campaign runs on every pull request/main update and weekly in deep mode across 14 parser/API/path/export targets: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/security/fuzzing.md
dynamic_analysis_unsafe_justification: Project-owned runtime code is Python and Rust, not a memory-unsafe language such as C or C++; native Rust boundaries are separately tested fail-closed.
dynamic_analysis_enable_assertions_justi: Pytest, property/fuzz checks, and Rust tests run with their validation/assertion mechanisms enabled before release.
dynamic_analysis_fixed_justification: No confirmed unresolved medium-or-higher vulnerability from dynamic analysis is known; fuzz failures are retained as artifacts and fail the campaign gate.
dco_justification: CONTRIBUTING.md documents DCO sign-off, scripts/ci_dco_check.py enforces it, and the main ruleset requires the DCO sign-off status: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md
osps_le_01_01_justification: Non-trivial contributions require a Signed-off-by assertion enforced by the required DCO sign-off check: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/.github/workflows/dco.yml
access_continuity_justification: The project remains solo-maintainer. A real backup maintainer or emergency steward must be added before this criterion is claimed: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/docs/governance/access-continuity.md
bus_factor_justification: The current bus factor is one; ZapTrace will not claim this criterion until a second trusted active maintainer or independent contributor is demonstrated: https://github.com/oaslananka/zaptrace/blob/main/MAINTAINERS.md
